description: A clear composition of a recognizable teapot, with improved visibility and spatial arrangement of key elements.

drawing_instructions.composition: The teapot is centered in the composition. The oval represents the main body of the teapot, with the circle above it representing the lid. A rectangle positioned towards the top right corner represents the handle, extending from near the center of the bottom of the teapot body. The spout is a line connecting the lower part of the teapot body to the handle. The orientation and spacing of these components are adjusted for clarity and recognition.
drawing_instructions.intent: Plan a clear composition of a teapot, ensuring its distinguishing visible components and spatial relationships are accurately represented. The subject should be recognizable without labels, with improved visual elements compared to the previous feedback.

This revision focuses on improving the visibility and spatial arrangement of these elements to ensure they can be easily identified without labels.
